question: How do I purchase fine art from you?
answer: We accept checks (via mail or in person). We also offer a lay-away-plan. We ask that you put down a portion of the painting’s purchase price to hold it and then make regular payments.
more: You will not be able to take receipt of the painting until the final payment has been made.
